sampling.eligibility: Issuer roster; listing_date <= 2025-11-11; positive same-date close and volume; not prior three samples
sampling.volume_reference: 2026-11-11 dailyQuotes 成交股數 (exact reported daily quote shares), distinct from monthly lots-based volume

limitations: 897 is the official OTC stock-company issuer-code roster, not an independently ISIN-classified security universe. The official schema describes common-stock par value, preferred-stock shares separately, and issued common shares or underlying TDR shares. All 897 codes are four-digit issuer codes; this alone is not instrument-class proof.

Exact issuer-code membership excludes ETF/warrant/preferred-series securities not present in the stock-company roster. Emerging companies have a separate official directory endpoint mopsfin_t187ap03_R and are outside this source. Per-instrument class of all excluded quote securities was not established.

Official ISIN classification lookup returned an HTTP 200 security-denial HTML page; no retry or alternative access flow was attempted. Independent exhaustive ordinary-equity classification is unavailable.

The 25 missing/absent normal-session closes remain in the 897 denominator. Only 4534 and 4804 are explicitly marked suspended by same-day tpex_cmode. A missing close does not mean suspension or zero shares, as odd-lot or other activity can exist.

45 issuers listed after 2025-11-11 remain in the roster, separately flagged and excluded only from the seasoned historical sampling pool. DateOfListing is officially documented as 上市日期 even in this OTC dataset.

Suspension history contains multiple years and non-equity securities. It is preserved verbatim rather than used to infer a complete daily status timeline. Same-day cmode only identifies flags present in that source; absence is not a guarantee of trading availability.

Monthly Volume_lots is official reported 成交張數 excluding block trades; Volume and Volume_shares_scaled equal reported lots*1000, not exact transaction shares. Turnover is reported thousands*1000. Do not compare volume to exact-share feeds with zero tolerance.

Missing OHLC rows are recorded separately and never synthesized. Historical interval is inclusive 2025-11-11 to 2026-11-11, 13 calendar-month queries per sample. No 2026-10-23 bar is inserted; known market closure is retained as absent.
This evidence verifies the official reference side only. It does not establish Fugle support, coverage, equivalence, or permission to use paid APIs.
